obs: "it is unquestionably a general rule, that the abrogation of one remedy does not affect another."
"The Suits in Admiralty Act was not intended to and did not touch those rights. As stated in the text, its remedies were added to them."

"Plainly FTCA is not a sufficient protector of the citizens constitutional rights, and without a clear congressional mandate we cannot hold that Congress relegated respondent exclusively to the FTCA remedy."
"We have also stressed that a plaintiffs ability to invoke 1983 cannot be defeated simply by [t]he availability of administrative mechanisms to protect the plaintiffs interests."
